card.name: Route-of-administration cautions and WARNINGS openers
card.fires_on: The word after a non-standard route (intramuscular, intra-arterial) such as "administration", and the word "use" right after a WARNINGS heading. It anticipates a caution statement.

modes.label: Route then administration
modes.description: The word "administration" or a route word after intramuscular or intra-arterial, where the text goes on to discourage that route.

modes.label: After WARNINGS heading
modes.description: The word "use" opening the first sentence under a WARNINGS heading.

modes.label: Dosing route heading
modes.description: A number or word inside an intravenous administration instruction with a restriction.
modes.example: Intravenous Administration: HUMALOG U-<<1>>00 ONLY Do NOT administer HUM

card.plain: It marks spots where the label is about to give a caution, such as against a route of giving the drug or at the start of a warnings section.
